The Ivory Sukundu: a website, from problem to launch.
A luxury hair-extensions brand, and a store that answers the questions customers ask.
Bought on trust, and on a number.
Which length, how many bundles, which texture. A standard store template answered none of it.
Where does 24 inches land on me?
How many bundles for a full look?
Straight or curly, for my routine?
Length became a guide: sixteen lengths from 10 to 40 inches, where each lands and how many bundles it takes. Texture became a quiz.
The order of things, before any colour.
Shop, then decide, then belong. This is where the site was actually decided.
Ivory, espresso and a little gold, an editorial serif, and nothing that looks like a discount store.
Live, then a store of its own.
